arms.candidate: same 14B base + LoRA adapter trained on verified fit-split repairs only
arms.deterministic_random: same 14B base + LoRA adapter trained on an equal number of unverified fit-split attempts (pool-matched, includes failing ones)
arms.fixed_policy: same base, k=4 verified fit repairs retrieved by module similarity as few-shot, no training

decision_rule: Pass iff candidate minus each of the three other arms has paired-bootstrap 95% lower bound >= min_effect_micro/2 and mean >= min_effect_micro, in at least 2 of 3 seeds, retention holds. Fail if any contrast mean < 0 or retention breaks. Otherwise Inconclusive (never positive). n_assess is small, so Inconclusive is the expected outcome unless the effect is large; per_module may be raised only in a NEW experiment id.
domain: 60 outside Python libraries; each task is one fix commit that changed exactly one source file and its tests. Buggy source = file at the parent commit; oracle = the commit changed test files, run in a network-less Docker container (python:3.11-slim plus the library test deps), green on the fix tree. Pass iff only the target file changes and those tests go green.
falsifier: if the pool-matched unverified adapter matches the verified one (difference lower bound <= 0), verification added nothing and the recursion thesis is not supported in this domain
hypothesis: Mid-size trainee on real changes: exp-021/024 had a 7B trainee at 3-4% (floor). A 14B trainee should sit above floor so the verified-vs-pool contrast becomes resolvable on the 172-task assess split.
known_limits: public repositories: the 32B proposer, the trainee base model, or both may have seen these fixes (contamination); the pool-matched control shares the exposure, so it isolates verification, but absolute rates are not clean

selection: tasks exist only where the fix commit changes exactly one source file with a regression test that fails before the fix and passes after, in small modules (<=12000 chars); this under-represents hard multi-file bugs
repository split is by library, so assess libraries are unseen but similar in style
tune split has only 36 tasks, so the retention check is coarse
assess tasks are regenerated from local git clones; the commit hashes are in the manifest
single trainee, one proposer, Python only

about 37% of the mined commits have fix-like subjects (fix, bug, error, ...); the rest are small feature or behaviour changes, so this is "real historical single-file changes with regression tests", not strictly bug fixes
the commit subject and test diff are visible to proposer and trainee: the test diff is the oracle spec, the subject may hint at the fix
assess prompts are rendered only to the evaluated arms, never to a proposer or trainer

the 36 added libraries were cloned, built and mined on a GCP VM (scripts/mine_gcp.sh) with images from pip install of the package then uninstall of the package itself; the oracle pre-check (green on fix tree, red with only the source file reverted) still gates every task
tune split is large (179) because many added libraries hash into it; retention check is more precise but evaluation is slower
training stack (PEFT bf16) differs from exp-011..021 (MLX 4-bit): only within-experiment contrasts are comparable
leakage_controls: assess repositories disjoint from fit/tune repositories
assess sources read from git at run time; no assess prompt is rendered to any proposer or trainer
oracle runs only the commit changed test files on the fix tree with a single source file replaced
oracle_audit: every task passed a pre-check: tests green on the fix tree and red with only the target file reverted to its parent version (scripts/mine_realbugs.py)
proposer: fit-split attempts are the exp-023 attempts (Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct bf16, vLLM, temp 0.8, K=12, spec prompt; 4140 attempts, 816 verified), copied and re-verified, not regenerated. Trainee and evaluated model: Qwen2.5-Coder-14B-Instruct bf16, so distillation from a larger model.
recipe: LoRA rank 8, alpha 32 (scale 4), q_proj and v_proj of the last 16 layers, Adam lr 1e-5, batch 1, steps = 3 x examples, bf16 base with gradient checkpointing (PEFT, scripts/train_remote.py). Abort as NotRun if loss exceeds max(2.0, 5 x first-step loss). Evaluation: vLLM greedy, max_tokens 400 (scripts/eval_remote.py). Fixed before any model run, not tuned on assess.
retention: tune-split pass rate (evaluated for untouched_base and candidate only) must not drop for the candidate versus untouched_base by more than 0.02
round_policy: Follows exp-024 Fail at floor (7B). Same corpus (realbugs-v2), proposer data, recipe, rule and thresholds; only the trainee changes to 14B. New candidate identity with new seeds. If the 14B base is itself near floor (<8%) or near ceiling, that is reported as such, not rescued. Floor >=100 kept. No tuning.
seeds_note: training seeds are separate from the split seed
status: Locked by ledger entry in ledgers/exp-025-bugrepair.jsonl before any model run.
training_floor: >=100 distinct verified fit repairs (<=3 per task); otherwise NotRun.
unit: assess task, one attempt per arm per seed
